punchline: A pill aimed at one protein: Gleevec and the leukemia it targeted.
thirty_sec: Ciba-Geigy found imatinib in 1992; by 1996 work with Brian Druker showed it killed CML cells and spared normal ones. After Novartis hesitated, Druker pushed for trials; the first high-dose patients all responded, and the FDA granted accelerated approval on 10 May 2001.
question: Can you name the specific mechanism behind the problem you are working on?
key_contrast: One known target versus improving everything a little.
